summary.text: Becky Massey is a Republican state senator from Knoxville representing District 6, part of Knox County, and a Senate member of the 107th through 114th General Assemblies. She chairs the Senate Transportation and Safety Committee and sits on the Health and Welfare Committee.

paragraphs.text: Massey was born on January 2, 1955, according to her legislative biography.
She earned a B.S. in Business Administration from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, in 1977.
Her biography lists roles as executive director of the Sertoma Center and president of Tennessee Community Organizations, and membership in Cedar Springs Presbyterian Church.
It also notes she was a delegate to the 1988 Republican National Convention.
